baseline_models.focus_anchor: The clause opens with أَفَرَءَيْتَ and predicates تَوَلَّىٰ of ٱلَّذِى.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seeing verb functions as an alerting demand for appraisal, while the relative clause supplies withdrawal as the case to diagnose.

activation_trace.role: The literal alerting 'tell me' formula makes the opening a demand for diagnosis rather than a neutral report.
Literal turning away and refusal supplies the conduct placed under diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Have you noticed someone who went away?
changed_reading.after: Attend to, and render an account of, the recognizable one whose defining act is refusal and withdrawal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The discourse turns the addressee's sight toward a subject characterized by turning away.
baseline_models.mechanism: Showing and facing are performatively opposed to withdrawal: the clause brings into view the very act by which its subject tries to remove attention and compliance.

activation_trace.role: Literal showing or making seen gives the question its exposing function.
Literal turning toward and facing supplies the orientation that the subject refuses.
Literal turning away supplies the counter-direction exposed by the question.

changed_reading.before: The addressee merely observes a departing person.
changed_reading.after: The utterance reverses the departure by turning scrutiny toward it: withdrawal itself is made publicly visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ belongs to a root field spanning adjacency, charge, alliance, and withdrawal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Withdrawal gains relational depth because it negates nearby possibilities of remaining close, taking charge, or sustaining allegiance; the act can therefore be dereliction, not only bodily departure.

activation_trace.role: Literal nearness supplies the relational proximity relinquished by withdrawal.
Literal assumption of charge supplies an entrusted relation that can be abandoned.
Literal loyal support supplies the allegiance from which the subject may detach.
Literal withdrawal converts those live relations into refused proximity, charge, or support.

changed_reading.before: One person turns away from an unspecified object.
changed_reading.after: One person abandons a relation of attention, allegiance, or responsibility that had called for continued nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier vision sequence joins truthful perception to a gaze that neither drifts nor exceeds its limit. Reopening with أَفَرَءَيْتَ places the later withdrawal against that calibrated mode of witness.

activation_trace.role: The alerting formula reopens seeing as an evaluative demand.
Turning away supplies the orientation contrasted with calibrated sight.
Eye or insight supplies the earlier act of truthful witness.
Literal drift or fatigue of sight, explicitly negated, defines one failed visual trajectory.
Literal eyesight identifies the faculty held steady in the prior scene.
Literal limit-crossing, explicitly negated, defines the other failure avoided by disciplined sight.

structural_cues: 53:11-18 repeatedly stages seeing before 53:33 reopens with the same interrogative root.
53:17 balances two negations around ٱلْبَصَرُ: neither lateral drift nor excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated seeing and explicit negations of visual drift and excess; I infer a contrastive arrow from calibrated witness to the subject's withdrawal. A live alternative is that the earlier scene validates revelation without characterizing this later person.

changed_reading.before: Look at a person who turns away.
changed_reading.after: Measure the turned-away posture against a prior gaze that remained true to its object and its limits; withdrawal reads as anti-witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same alerting question first tests named objects, after which conjecture and desire replace knowledge, and turning from remembrance follows. The focus subject becomes a case in an epistemic allegiance rather than an isolated avoider.

activation_trace.role: The alerting formula presents the subject as another case for examination.
Withdrawal is the final posture whose epistemic pathway is reconstructed.
The earlier identical alerting formula establishes a precedent for exposing a false object of commitment.
Literal inclination of desire supplies a selected direction for the self.
Literal doubt and imagining supplies the insecure cognition followed in place of warrant.
Knowledge as disclosure is explicitly absent, sharpening the contrast with conjectural following.
Turning one's side away supplies the commanded disengagement from an already disengaged person.
The repeated literal withdrawal ties the focus subject to turning from remembrance.

structural_cues: 53:23-30 orders unsupported naming, conjecture, desire, withdrawal from remembrance, and a stated limit of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and its repeated roots; I infer that desire-backed conjecture can feed withdrawal and stabilize an allegiance. The materially live reverse arrow is that prior withdrawal constricts what the person is willing to know.

changed_reading.before: The subject performs a standalone refusal.
changed_reading.after: The subject's withdrawal is the enacted endpoint of an epistemic allegiance: desire and conjecture orient attention away from remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after forbidding self-purification and reserving true knowledge of persons, the command to see 'the one' can act as a mirror: scrutiny of another also tests the observer's self-exemption.

activation_trace.role: Literal visible appearance and mirror supplies the reflexive potential of seeing the case.
Withdrawal remains the concrete conduct reflected back toward the observer.
Knowledge as disclosure reserves the decisive diagnosis beyond self-assertion.
The self or thing itself supplies the reflexive object that may be concealed by judging another.
Literal purity and rectitude supplies the self-certification prohibited immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 53:32 ends with فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ and divine knowledge; 53:33 immediately asks the addressee to see a third-person case.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirror-like visibility, selfhood, purification, and immediate adjacency; I infer that the deictic case can rebound on the addressee. The live alternative is a wholly external exemplum with no reflexive force.

changed_reading.after: Use the external case as a diagnostic mirror: naming another's withdrawal must not become a covert certificate of one's own purity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next coordinated predicates give withdrawal a temporal and material profile: transfer begins, remains slight, then meets hard ground and is cut off. Turning away becomes an arrested process, not a single pivot.

activation_trace.role: Literal uninterrupted succession supplies the continuation that the following cutoff defeats.
Literal withdrawal names the overall retreat whose internal sequence follows.
Literal handing over or giving supplies the initiated transfer.
Literal smallness constrains that transfer before it can become sustained giving.
Hard earth stopping excavation supplies the material mechanics of an effort that can go no farther.
A little gift followed by withholding states the social result of the same stoppage.

structural_cues: 53:34 continues the subject of ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ with two coordinated perfect verbs.
قَلِيلًا intervenes between initiated giving and the terminal وَأَكْدَىٰ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a single subject, ordered verbs, slight quantity, hard substrate, and cutoff; I infer that 53:34 specifies how withdrawal unfolds. A live alternative treats the verbs as a list of separate faults rather than one causal process.

changed_reading.after: The subject retreats by beginning a transfer, limiting it, and then stopping as though effort has struck impenetrable ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next question opposes hidden reality to claimed seeing. The addressee can inspect the subject's visible withdrawal, while the subject's cutoff is challenged as though it rested on privileged foresight.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment makes the opening an appraisal of the subject's basis for acting.
Withdrawal is the observable decision whose unseen warrant is challenged.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies the alleged access posed by the question.
Literal concealment from eyes defines what the subject cannot simply inspect.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the questioned inference from hidden knowledge to confident vision.

structural_cues: 53:35 directly follows the giving-and-cutoff sequence and asks whether the subject has knowledge of the unseen so that he sees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, knowledge, and seeing in a rhetorical question; I infer that the withdrawal is exposed as behavior pretending to secure foresight. The alternative is that 53:35 attacks only a separate claim and gives no motive for 53:33-34.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is merely asked whether the subject was seen.
changed_reading.after: Visible withdrawal is set against counterfeit foresight: the subject acts decisively without the unseen knowledge that could warrant confidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conveyed written record states that burdens do not transfer, each person has only their own effort, that effort will be exposed, and settlement will be complete. Withdrawal therefore reads as a failed exit from an individually attached account.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge supplies the responsibility from which the subject appears to resign.
Transfer at a known account value supplies a legal-economic image for the attempted disengagement.
A report brought and conveyed supplies the accountable notice the subject should have received.
The written sheet gives durable documentary form to that notice.
Completion without deficiency supplies the model of fulfilled obligation.
The heavy load supplies the liability that remains attached to its bearer.
Work and acquisition assign the person an account consisting of their own earned action.
Making seen turns private effort into exposed evidence.
Collecting and settling a debt supplies the accounting mechanics of recompense.
Completion without deficiency closes the account that withdrawal cannot evade.

structural_cues: 53:36-41 moves from received record to non-transferable burden, owned effort, public visibility, and full recompense.
The repeated singular human possessor in 53:39-40 keeps effort attached to its actor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies documentary notice, attached burden, owned work, exposure, and full settlement; I infer that turning away functions like attempted resignation or transfer of an account. The live alternative is that the account only supplies later consequences, not the inner mechanics of withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: The subject leaves a relation or demand behind.
changed_reading.after: The subject attempts to leave an obligation whose burden, work, visibility, and settlement remain non-transferably attached to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence names the final endpoint, depicts overturning and descent, announces an event drawing near, and ends in bodily bowing. The focus withdrawal becomes one trajectory inside a field that ultimately demands reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Turning toward and facing supplies the orientation available but refused in the focus.
Turning away supplies the chosen counter-trajectory.
The terminal limit supplies the destination against which every orientation is measured.
Overturning and diverting from a direction materializes catastrophic reversal.
Falling into a depth supplies the downward consequence within that reversal.
Drawing near converts the endpoint from abstraction into approaching pressure.
Bowing the head supplies the final bodily counter-orientation to turning away.

structural_cues: After 53:33, the surah moves through ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ, an overturned descent, the approaching event, and the final imperative to prostrate.
The focus verb and closing bodily command can both be rendered as changes of orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endpoint, reversal, descent, approach, and bowing; I infer a spatial arrow that makes ethical withdrawal a trajectory. The live alternative keeps these as separate eschatological episodes without a continuous spatial model.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is a local refusal completed in the moment.
changed_reading.after: Turning away begins a trajectory toward an unavoidable endpoint, set against the final commanded act of bodily reorientation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries human withdrawal through rain, ripening, and barren-ground branches. It remains anchored in تَوَلَّىٰ and the immediately following small gift and cutoff. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological-material analogy, never as a replacement for volitional turning away.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root permits both following rain and dates beginning to dry, while 53:34 supplies scant giving and arrested growth.

activation_trace.role: Rain that should follow earlier rain supplies an expected second provision in a sequence.
Dates beginning to dry or change color supplies premature desiccation within apparent ripeness.
Literal scantness limits the provision actually yielded.
Slow growth and a barren year supplies the failed ecological continuation.

changed_reading.after: The person resembles a provisioning or ripening process that begins, yields little, and then dries or fails to continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a pastoral separation branch is activated by the preceding fetal and maternal imagery. It remains anchored in the focus withdrawal root and 53:32's explicit womb-origin sequence. Downstream prose should mark self-severing from dependence as an analogy, not claim that تَوَلَّىٰ denotes livestock separation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَوَلَّىٰ can activate separation of young animals from their mothers directly after the reminder of embryonic life in mothers' wombs.

activation_trace.role: Separating young livestock from their mothers supplies the strange but concrete image of severed dependence.
Growth and nurture supplies development from dependence toward agency.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies the dependent early state.
The interior or belly supplies the enclosing site of that dependence.
The mother as bearer and nurturer supplies the origin from which imagined autonomy severs itself.

changed_reading.before: The subject turns away from an external demand.
changed_reading.after: The subject enacts a self-severing autonomy, disowning the dependence and nurture from which the self arose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping for the focus seeing form and joins residue to a commercial transfer branch. It remains packet-licensed and anchored to both focus roots, then gains support from cutoff and full settlement. Downstream prose must label it a form-distant lexical resonance and retain ordinary seeing as primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping of أَفَرَءَيْتَ offers report and residue branches, while تَوَلَّىٰ offers transfer at cost.

activation_trace.role: Relaying a report supplies an exploratory sense of presenting the subject's account for examination.
A remaining residue supplies what is left unsettled after partial performance.
Transfer resale at a known price supplies the attempted reassignment of an account.
A little gift followed by withholding creates the residue-producing cutoff.
Debt collection and settlement supplies the later reckoning of the remainder.
Completion without deficiency blocks the fantasy that a residue can remain outside settlement.

changed_reading.before: The opening asks the addressee to see a person who withdrew.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, it calls for the account of one who cuts performance short, leaves a remainder, and cannot transfer away the demand for full settlement.

strongest_changes: The opening becomes diagnostic exposure rather than neutral observation.
Earlier calibrated sight and later counterfeit foresight turn withdrawal into an epistemic orientation.
53:34 renders withdrawal as initiated but scant giving that strikes hard ground and stops.
53:36-41 makes the withdrawn obligation an individually attached account that will be exposed and settled in full.
summary.what_was_special: Seeing and turning coexist as a counter-directional pair: the text makes withdrawal visible, reflects it toward the observer, follows its material cutoff, and carries it into documentary, bodily, ecological, and relational models without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal direction among desire, constrained knowledge, and withdrawal remains reversible.
The mirror reading may be a reflexive effect of adjacency or only an external exemplum.
The ecological, maternal-separation, commercial, and split-root residue models are live analogies whose lexical distance must remain explicit.
